summary: STANDALONE MODE verification for Ledgr (backend intentionally STOPPED). 9 of 10 flows PASS end-to-end on the mobile web preview (390x844) with ZERO backend /api/* calls throughout. All AsyncStorage-backed CRUD works: create supplier (btn-add-supplier → input-supplier-name → btn-save-supplier), bill $80 (btn-add-bill → supplier-chip → input-amount → btn-save-bill), sale $200 (tile-sales → input-sale-amount → btn-save-sale), drawing $10 (tile-payments → ptype-drawing → input-payment-amount → btn-save-payment), inventory close (input-actual-stock 500 → btn-close-init → btn-close-confirm). AGGREGATES verified exactly: Sales $200, Purchases $80, Gross Profit $120, Drawings $10, Net Profit $110 (commission=0). COMMISSION 20%: Profit Flow card shows 'Manager Commission (20%) − $24.00' and Net Profit correctly drops to $86.00 (=200-80-24-10). RESET preserves googleApiKey + fcRate (verified fcRate=2500 survived reset) and wipes suppliers/bills/sales/payments/inventoryChecks/periods. CLOSE PERIOD: Opening Balance $500 shown after closing with actualStock=500, totals reset to $0, and hero label switches to 'NET PROFIT SINCE {nextDay}'. Regression: prev/today/next daily arrows work (btn-day-prev / btn-day-next), profit-flow testID present. NO NETWORK CALLS to /api/* fired across full test run (0 total). Deprecated warnings only ('shadow*' / 'pointerEvents') — pre-existing benign RN Web noise. ONE CRITICAL BUG FOUND: gemini.ts hard-codes MODEL='gemini-3.5-flash', which is NOT a real Google model — all voice/OCR/testKey calls with a valid key will 404. ONE MINOR: btn-test-key with empty key does not produce a visible on-page error on web preview (likely uses native Alert). Edit-bill flow not retested end-to-end (test selector 'bill-row-*' is wrong — actual testID pattern is 'bill-{id}').

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping btn-test-key with an empty googleApiKey does not surface any visible error on the web preview (no 'Missing Google Gemini API key' text rendered, no browser dialog). If the message is emitted via a native Alert.alert it won't render on web — replace with an inline <Text testID="test-key-error"> so the 401 path is verifiable on web too. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx (test-key handler)

integration_issues.flow: Gemini AI (voice / OCR / testKey / parseCommand / transcribe / reconcile)
integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: /app/frontend/src/db/gemini.ts line 6 sets `const MODEL = 'gemini-3.5-flash'` — this model does not exist on the Google Generative Language API. Real available models are gemini-1.5-flash, gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-2.5-flash. Every AI call with a real key will return HTTP 404 ('models/gemini-3.5-flash is not found'). Fix: update MODEL to 'gemini-2.5-flash' (or 'gemini-2.0-flash'). This will silently break every AI feature end-to-end even though the standalone plumbing is correct. Reference: /app/frontend/src/db/gemini.ts:6

critical_code_review_comments: local.ts is well-structured — all aggregates computed in TypeScript, currency conversion via toUsd(), commission only applied when grossProfit > 0, cash = openingCash + totalSales - supplierPayments - drawings (correct — commission is a liability, not a cash out).
resetAll() correctly preserves googleApiKey + fcRate and resets managerCommissionPct/currentPeriodStart/openingInventory/openingCash — matches spec.

closePeriod() correctly rolls actualStock into next period's openingInventory and d.cash into openingCash, and shifts currentPeriodStart to tomorrow — verified: 'NET PROFIT SINCE 2026-07-18' shown post-close.
gemini.ts is otherwise clean (direct fetch to generativelanguage.googleapis.com, 401 short-circuit on missing key, JSON schema-based responses) — only the model name is wrong.
api.ts is a thin façade delegating to db + gemini — no residual fetch to backend anywhere in /app/frontend/src or /app/frontend/app (grep confirms).

importBackup() uses replace semantics (overwrites each collection) — matches _meta.version=2 export shape. Round-trip export/import couldn't be automated in headless browser (file picker) — main agent should manually verify once.

rca_of_issue: Gemini model 404: during the client-server → standalone migration the model constant was set to 'gemini-3.5-flash' — a non-existent Google model (available families are 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.5). Reproduce: Settings → paste any valid Gemini API key → save → tap btn-test-key → expected 200 'OK' reply, actual will be a 404 error 'models/gemini-3.5-flash is not found for API version v1beta'. Same 404 will fire for parseCommand, transcribe, ocrReceipt, reconcileStatementAI. Fix: /app/frontend/src/db/gemini.ts:6 → `const MODEL = 'gemini-2.5-flash';`. No other code change needed — schemas, endpoint, and auth flow are correct.
